eligibility.evidence: Sec. 3.2-3.3: GPT-4o plays the 'alien game' (NK-landscape search, exploration vs exploitation) taken from Billinger et al. 2021 human lab study; responses compared with original human data (Sec. 4.1, Figs 1-2). Borderline: a strategy-search task rather than a classic cognitive paradigm; the paper calls it a single experimental paradigm (Sec. 5.4).

A.title: Reproducing and Extending Experiments in Behavioral Strategy with Large Language Models

paradigms.name: Alien game: search on NK fitness landscapes (K = 0, 5, 9; whether and where to search, exploit vs explore)
paradigms.source_paper: Billinger, Srikanth, Stieglitz & Schumacher 2021, Strateg. Manag. J. 42(2); variant of Billinger et al. 2014 used as robustness check
paradigms.location: Sec. 3.2-3.3 (same NK landscape and instructions as original, symbols renamed with Greek letters; 24 trials per landscape)

D.population: not_reported (participants of the original Billinger et al. 2021 laboratory experiment; raw data obtained from the original authors)
D.metric: share of agents still actively searching per trial; search distance (Hamming distance to best prior configuration)

effects.label: AGREEMENT-ONLY
effects.location: Sec. 4.1, Figs 1-2: trends in active search and search distance reproduced; mean search distance 1.31 (LLM) vs 2.36 (human), p<0.001; Sec. 4.2, Table 1 (Heckman regression, 900 think-aloud agents) concurs with the human study qualitatively. No correspondence statistic reported. GPT-3.5 results appear only inside the 69+14 mixed sample (Sec. 4.3, Fig. 4: mean 2.20 vs human 2.37), so no separate GPT-3.5 row.

E.headline: GPT-4o agents reproduce the human pattern of whether and where to search, but search more locally and with lower variance; mixing in GPT-3.5 restores variance.

G.notes: OpenAI default decoding settings, temperature not stated (fn 2). Robustness checks (alternative framings, small prompt deviations, Billinger 2014 reproduction, Sec. 4.4) are described only qualitatively; one deviation removed stopping behaviour. GPT-4o/3.5 only despite 'a few other LLMs' tested (Sec. 5.4). No code link; full prompts not given. Outcome_kind coded agreement as no normative key or manipulation contrast fits (ambiguous).
